definitions.explanation: A person who cooks as a profession, especially one skilled in preparing food.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{料理人|りょうりにん}だ。
あの{店|みせ}の{料理人|りょうりにん}は{腕|うで}がいいと{評判|ひょうばん}だ。
examples.english: The chef at that restaurant has a reputation for being skilled.

examples.japanese: {一流|いちりゅう}の{料理人|りょうりにん}になるには、{何年|なんねん}もの{修行|しゅぎょう}が{必要|ひつよう}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that becoming a top-class chef requires many years of training.

notes:
{料理人|りょうりにん} refers to someone who cooks professionally. It has a traditional, artisan feel and is often used for Japanese cuisine chefs.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シェフ: chef (Western cuisine, head of kitchen)
- コック: cook (Western cuisine, from Dutch "kok")
- {板前|いたまえ}: Japanese cuisine chef (works at the counter)
- {調理師|ちょうりし}: licensed cook (official qualification title)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {腕|うで}のいい{料理人|りょうりにん}: a skilled cook
- {一流|いちりゅう}の{料理人|りょうりにん}: a first-rate chef
- {料理人|りょうりにん}を{目指|めざ}す: to aspire to be a chef
